dict.string: Lumen reads and writes calendar events you ask an agent to handle. Writes are tagged so a restart does not create a second copy.
Lumen creates reminders you ask for. Each reminder stores an effect key so a retry updates the same item.
Lumen searches your contacts when you ask an agent to find a person.
Lumen turns your voice into a message for the agent. Audio is recognized on device when Apple allows it.
Lumen uses the microphone while you dictate a message.
Lumen scans a page so the agent can read it.
Lumen uses Face ID to unlock the app and to approve high-risk actions.
